short: A congruence integer for rank-three unitary representations

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Af.CongruenceNumberRankThree
lean.plain: A congruence integer for rank-three unitary representations
lean.note: In the first $\mathrm{U}(3)$ formulation, one size-controlled integer bounds the sum of $\ell$-adic valuations of the Frobenius trace differences from an Eisenstein trace for every coefficient prime $\ell\notin\{2,p\}$. Lean derives this formulation under separate hypotheses, and the compiled RH argument uses the version with different admissibility conditions.
